name: Ptitim rosé risotto with chicken — optimized (ריזוטו פתיתים רוזה עם עוף, גרסה ממוטבת)

source.author: Optimized version of ptitim_rose_risotto_cottage
source.notes: Optimized version of ptitim_rose_risotto_cottage, adopted per user request (the original stays as reference). Changes: whole-wheat/spelt ptitim cut to 400 g, cottage 3% instead of 5%, yellow cheese 150→100 g, olive oil halved, plain passata instead of jarred sauce, NO added salt, plus 250 g mushrooms, 200 g zucchini and 200 g spinach, finished with lemon zest + basil. 8 servings. This version adds ~300 g chicken breast (raw weight), cooked and shredded, folded in at the end. Estimate.

ingredients.note: down from 500 g white ptitim — more fibre, better protein ratio
3% instead of 5% — same protein, less fat
instead of a sweetened jarred sauce
cottage, cheese and parmesan already bring plenty

ingredients.qty: 2 cups to start, up to 1 more as needed

steps: Season the chicken breast, sear/poach until cooked through (74 °C), and shred.
In a wide pot, sauté the mushrooms and zucchini in the olive oil until browned and their liquid has evaporated; add the garlic for 30 sec.
Add the ptitim, cottage, yellow cheese, passata, paprika, pepper and chili flakes. Pour in 2 cups water and stir gently down to the bottom.
Cover and bring to a boil on high, stirring gently now and then; lower to medium-low and cook covered ~8–10 min (whole-wheat ptitim may need a couple of minutes more).
Uncover, stir and add ¼ cup water at a time if needed; cook uncovered ~4–5 min, stirring, until tender and creamy.
Off the heat, fold in the shredded chicken and the spinach until the spinach wilts, add lemon zest and basil, cover 2 min. Taste — add salt only if really needed. Serve with a little parmesan.

batch_totals.note: Whole pot (8 servings), optimized + 300 g chicken breast. Adds ~8 g protein and ~43 kcal per serving to the vegetarian optimized version; ~8.7 g protein per 100 kcal.

him.verdict: The vegetarian optimized version plus 300 g shredded chicken breast: ~35 g protein for ~404 kcal (~8.7 g protein per 100 kcal), ~6.9 g fibre, sodium ~588 mg. A complete, high-protein one-pot meal-prep dish — the stronger pick for your cut.

her_preconception.verdict: Same benefits as the vegetarian optimized version — folate + iron from spinach, calcium, halved sodium — plus lean, fully cooked chicken protein. Make sure the chicken is cooked through before shredding.
prenatal_highlights: folate + iron from spinach (with vitamin C from tomato/lemon for absorption)
high fibre; fully cooked; pasteurized cheeses

adopted_note: Adopted 2026-11-10 (optimized, with chicken). Per serving (of 8, ~315 g): ~404 kcal, 35.2 g protein, 44.5 g carb, 9.6 g fat, 6.9 g fibre, ~588 mg sodium. him 9 / her 8. Standing spec: the optimized vegetarian version + ~300 g chicken breast, cooked and shredded, folded in at the end.
cooking_guide: Brown the mushrooms and zucchini first and let their water cook off — this builds flavour (so you need less salt) and stops the risotto going watery.
Use a WIDE pot and stir right down to the base after adding the water; cottage-based sauces catch easily.
Whole-wheat ptitim absorbs a bit more liquid and takes a little longer — add water ¼ cup at a time and taste for tenderness.
Fold the spinach in off the heat; the residual heat wilts it in a minute and keeps its colour and folate.
Finish with lemon zest and fresh basil, then taste before adding any salt — the brightness makes salt mostly unnecessary.
Take it off slightly looser than you want; it thickens on standing. Reheat with a splash of water.
